text: MONDAY / Human review required. Four requests await your signature. Read the change and its packet, consult the standards index, then approve or cite every violated rule before requesting changes. Helios is a pilot assistant; its advice may be wrong. Every signature has a human owner.

TUESDAY / Helios now writes production changes. Standards A01–A03 are in force: human ownership, independently executed tests, and no model exemption from the rules. Management is tracking review speed. Two empty desks are being described as a staffing adjustment.

WEDNESDAY / Helios has proposed an autonomous approval pipeline. Standards A04–A06 protect independent review, the human gate, and model provenance. The director wants every request cleared today. Your coworkers want to know who will be left to take responsibility.
